All limits · Download help

Add numbers with room to spare

Page numbers appear at the bottom center as the current page and total page count. The number refers to output order, including cover pages. Review pages with footnotes or content near the bottom edge so the added text does not overlap important material.

Existing printed numbers are not removed. If your PDF already has pagination, this can create two numbering systems. On previously rotated pages, placement follows PDF page coordinates and needs visual review.

Need help saving the result? · How local processing works

Worked example: Page numbers

Practice input: four-page practice report. These files contain no real personal information.

  1. Select the practice report.
  2. Choose Add page numbers and download the result.
  3. Inspect the bottom center of every page for the new numbering. Keep it clear of existing text.

Expected result: Four pages, with a new page counter at the bottom center. The original sample labels remain.

If the result is not what you expected

This does not erase existing printed numbers or skip a cover. Use another workflow if you need Roman numerals, chapter numbering or different margins.

Report a problem with the tool name, browser and steps. Please do not send private documents.
